title: psycopg 3 through PgBouncer fails after a few runs with 'prepared statement "_pg3_0" already exists'
symptoms: Errors start only after the same query has run about five times on one connection
cause: psycopg 3 prepares a query on the server once it has run prepare_threshold times (5 by default) on a connection, and a transaction pooler can send the next use to a session with a different set of statements.
fix: Set prepare_threshold to None for pooled connections. psycopg 3.2 can keep them only with PgBouncer 1.22 or later, max_prepared_statements above 0, and libpq 17 or later on the client.
apply:
conn = psycopg.connect(DSN, prepare_threshold=None)
# psycopg_pool: ConnectionPool(DSN, kwargs={"prepare_threshold": None})
affected: psycopg 3.x (default threshold 5); conditional PgBouncer support from psycopg 3.2
